A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus from the House of Constantine dating AD335-337. Reece period 17. Reverse: Two soldiers stood either side of one standard. Obverse: Diademed bust right. Obverse inscription: Illegible. Reverse: Two soldiers stood either side of one standard. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Mint mark: Illegible. Die axis measurement: 12.00. Dimensions: diameter: 12.77mm; weight: 1.22g
